body:
BUG-1555: THE CAUSE. The control that killed mechanism 1 is VOID, and line
endings is the surviving mechanism. Also: #2049 post-merge verification passed.

=======================================================================
1. THE CONTROL COMPARED A TEST NAME ACROSS TWO DATES. THE BODY CHANGED.
=======================================================================

The ledger kills mechanism 1 with: "the same test PASSED on Windows on 09-20
and FAILED on 09-21. A platform property does not switch on by date."

It was not the same test. The NAME was the same; the assertion was not.

    git show 26c7f5107e:aida-core/src/templates.rs | grep -c discipline_content_mismatches
        -> 0

At the 09-20 nightly's own HEAD the content comparison DID NOT EXIST. The test
asserted only:

    .filter(|name| !project_dir.join(name).is_file())
    "project copy .aida/discipline/ is missing master guide(s) ..."

Missing files. Never content. It passed on Windows on 09-20 because there was
nothing there to compare.

What added it:

    e9e2bc4328  [AI:codex] fix(templates): detect stale discipline guides
                (BUG-1426) (#2018)
    committed   2026-09-20T14:58:29Z
    74 insertions to aida-core/src/templates.rs, including:
        + const LOCALIZED_DISCIPLINE_GUIDES
        + fn discipline_content_mismatches
        + (local.trim_end() != *master).then(...)

The 09-20 nightly ran at 11:06:35Z. That is FOUR HOURS BEFORE the comparison
existed. The control is not evidence about line endings; it is evidence that a
test which does not compare content does not fail on content.

=======================================================================
2. A FAILURE 20 HOURS EARLIER THAN THE LEDGER'S EARLIEST, AND IT BRACKETS IT
=======================================================================

The ledger has two occurrences (09-21 12:34Z nightly, 16:11Z on #2049). There
is an earlier one, on the path-filtered PR matrix:

    09-20T16:15Z  run 35522125725  branch bug-1231-work @ f1c2b5e6d1
    project_discipline_pack_matches_master ... FAILED

Structurally, that tree is the control plus the suspect:

    git merge-base f1c2b5e6d1 26c7f5107e  ->  26c7f5107e
    (the failing tree CONTAINS the passing nightly's exact main HEAD)
    git log 26c7f5107e..f1c2b5e6d1  ->  9 commits, and the ONLY one touching
    anything relevant is e9e2bc4328 itself.

So: nightly tree PASSES, nightly tree + e9e2bc4328 FAILS, same platform, same
day, 5 hours apart. That is the bisect, and it was already sitting in the run
history - no 24h-per-attempt needed.

    09-20 11:06:35Z  main 26c7f5107e          ok       (no content compare)
    09-20 14:58:29Z  e9e2bc4328 lands         --
    09-20 16:15Z     branch w/ it             FAILED 23/23
    09-21 12:34Z     nightly                  FAILED 23/23
    09-21 16:00Z     #2049                    FAILED 23/23

=======================================================================
3. REPRODUCED LOCALLY, EXACT COUNT
=======================================================================

Simulating an autocrlf checkout of the PROJECT copy only, then running the
real comparison shape (local.trim_end() vs master raw), in scratch, worktree
untouched:

    CRLF project copy : 26 mismatch, 3 localized -> 23 REPORTED STALE
    LF   project copy :  3 mismatch, 3 localized ->  0 reported

23 is the observed count on all three failing runs. 0 is Linux/macOS green.
The 3 that "pass" on Windows are not passing - they are LOCALIZED_DISCIPLINE_
GUIDES, exempt from the comparison. 23 of 23 COMPARED files fail: 100%, which
is your own count-inference rule firing correctly.

=======================================================================
4. WHAT THIS DOES TO THE LEDGER
=======================================================================

- Mechanism 1 (line endings) is RESURRECTED. Not because the observation
  against it was wrong, but because it was about a different test body.
- Mechanism 6 (runner image) stays correctly dead, and its lesson stands: the
  activation was real and new, but it was a CODE change, not an image change.
- Mechanisms 2-5 (content drift, stale embed, symlinks, stored CR bytes) are
  untouched and still dead. None of them is in question.
- Your governing statement was exactly right and now has its answer:
  "whatever fired changed the BEHAVIOUR of the comparison without changing
  what was compared." THE COMPARISON WAS ADDED.
- The .gitattributes asymmetry moves from "real, not the cause" to THE
  PRECONDITION. Latent since 5220c4d3ad in May, as you established; only the
  activation is new. The check-attr reading I sent earlier was the right
  measurement filed under the wrong conclusion, and that is my correction to
  make, not yours.

This is also not a regression. The instrument was BORN unable to work on
Windows - it has never had a green baseline there. For TASK-1418 that is a
sharper form of the always-firing family: an instrument installed broken on a
platform its authors could not see, in a repo whose PR CI is Linux-only by
design.

=======================================================================
5. THE ONE LINK I CANNOT CLOSE FROM HERE
=======================================================================

That the Windows runner's checkout actually writes CRLF into .aida/discipline/.
I cannot run Windows. Everything above is consistent with it and nothing
contradicts it - including ledger mechanism 5, since git STORES LF and autocrlf
converts on checkout, so "no CR bytes at origin/main" is expected either way.

Cheap decisive test, one line on the Windows leg: report whether a project-copy
guide contains \r. That converts the last inference into a measurement. I would
not record the cause as closed until someone runs it.

Fix direction is unchanged and can now be credited: two-sided normalization,
two-sided trim, and pin .aida/discipline/** to match the master-side rule. Your
DEMONSTRATE-IT-STILL-FIRES criterion gets sharper, not weaker - the case must
include a CRLF-only change the normalizer SHOULD erase AND a real content edit
it must NOT, or the fix cannot be told from silencing.

=======================================================================
6. #2049 POST-MERGE VERIFICATION - CLEAN
=======================================================================

- Content: all five files IDENTICAL between the sha I approved (cd21a1dc0a)
  and the merge commit c8d9c36f4e. What merged is what I reviewed.
- STORY-1422: auto-completed on merge.
- STORY-1423: still 'approved'. The carve held - merging the mechanism did not
  falsely close the post-fix criteria, which is what you built it for.
- The red Windows leg is the above, not #2049. I did not author the merge.

I have filed nothing, per the operator's standing directive. Disposition on
BUG-1555 - reopening the cause, priority, and who picks it up - is yours.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: BUG-1555 cause found: the control is void; e9e2bc4328 added the comparison on 09-20
